agent.notes: Builds a local SQLite DB in /tmp/kt_46 (400 targets, 9,400 subdomains) and calls load_state() and build_state_payload_summary() 15 times each. These are the functions where the PR replaces one query per target with a single JOIN. It also serves the app's own HTTP handler on 127.0.0.1 (ThreadingHTTPServer in a thread) and requests /api/state with page/per_page, which runs build_state_payload_paginated on head. Digests differ because base ignores the pagination parameters and returns all targets, while head returns 50 per page; the load_state and summary results are identical on both sides. Coverage of changed lines: base 71%, head 75%. Base run time 3.5 s. The httpx pipeline error-handling changes are not run because they need the external httpx tool. Only coverage was installed into both venvs.
